crates/gui/src/usage/refs.rs: references panel for the selection (symbol or variable) listing every UseSite (file:line + snippet + kind badge), grouped by file, jump-to each, count header; Ctrl+click on an identifier in the editor opens refs for it. Ctrl+P quick-open overlay over all files (fuzzy path match, reuses search scoring) as a new PaletteKind. Breadcrumbs row (module path > file > symbol) in Text mode header, each segment clickable. Owner: crates/gui/src/usage/refs.rs, app.rs palette/keys, text/ header. Verify: cargo build/clippy/test -p repowalk-gui; refs count for a fixture symbol matches grep (accounting for comments/strings).

PROGRESS (TEXT-03, 2026-10-15T14:52:16Z) - core half (a) done, GUI half (b) remains:
- DONE: crates/core/src/refs.rs implemented for real. All four original signatures kept. Duplicates are NOT deduped (two use sites on the same file/line are two references; rule stated in the module preamble).
- API: references(&Analysis,&str)->Vec<UseSite> (union, file/line order); references_ex(&Analysis,&str)->RefSet{resolved:Vec<UseSite>,by_name:Vec<UseSite>} (R-20 honesty split); references_of_kind(&Analysis,&str,UseKind)->Vec<UseSite>; reference_counts(&Analysis)->Vec<(String,usize)> (count desc, ties by target id asc); referencing_files(&Analysis,&str)->Vec<String>; references_by_file(&Analysis,&str)->Vec<(String,Vec<UseSite>)>; RefSet::{len,is_empty,all}.
- RESOLUTION SPLIT: target may be a canonical id OR a raw name. A use is `resolved` when its UseSite.target is a known canonical id in the Analysis (variable id, type id, cfg symbol, enclosing symbol, type-edge endpoint) and `by_name` when it is an unresolved raw name. When queried by name, ids declared with that name (variables/types) land in resolved; the raw-name uses land in by_name. LIMITATION: only Variable (id<->name) and TypeNode (id<->name) carry a name next to an id in Analysis, so function/method name-only uses cannot be linked to their symbol id from Analysis alone - query those by id.
- ORDERING: sites by (file,line,col,kind) with a stable sort; counts deterministic under input-order shuffles.
- TESTS: 7 new inline tests (resolved-vs-name-only for a variable and a type name; variable id -> VarRead/VarWrite; counts ordering + determinism; duplicates kept; grouping; empty analysis).
- GATES (real output): `cargo fmt --all -- --check` exit 0; `cargo clippy -p repowalk-core --all-targets -- -D warnings` Finished, 0 warnings; `cargo test -p repowalk-core` 128 lib tests passed, 0 failed.
- REMAINS (GUI half (b), do NOT start here): crates/gui/src/usage/refs.rs panel (list every UseSite with file:line + snippet + kind badge, grouped by file, jump-to, count header, Ctrl+click, Ctrl+P quick open, breadcrumbs) plus app.rs palette/key wiring by the integrator. The GUI must surface the resolved/by_name distinction from references_ex rather than a flat list. No new deps; nothing committed.

The no-refs hint states the documented linkage limitation (function/method name-only uses cannot be tied to an id from Analysis alone) instead of guessing.
